tickets.title: Sample: retire the weekly digest email
tickets.plain: The weekly digest email repeats what the rulings page already shows.
tickets.question: Stop sending the weekly digest email?

explainer.what: A Monday email that lists the open tickets.
explainer.background: The rulings page went live and lists the same tickets.
explainer.stakes: Two places to read one list, and the email goes stale by Tuesday.

evidence.gist: You asked whether anyone still reads the email.

tickets.body:
## What to build

Stop the weekly digest email.

> Sample quoted text from an earlier comment.

- [ ] Email no longer sent
- [ ] Page links kept

options.label: Retire the email
options.detail: Turn the email off and keep the page.

options.label: Already done
options.detail: It was turned off last week.

tickets.title: Sample: move the digest to Fridays
tickets.plain: If the email stays, send it on Friday afternoon instead of Monday morning.
tickets.question: Which day should the digest go out?

options.label: Friday
options.detail: Send on Friday at 3 p.m. Central.
